﻿Ahmad Haris Fahmi 
aharisfahmi.work@gmail.com | +6285384568854 | https://www.linkedin.com/in/aharisfahmi | https://aharisfahmi.github.io
  



SUMMARY
Backend Developer with 6 years of experience in Golang and PHP, building backend systems across enterprise financial ERP, university-scale HRIS and attendance platforms. Strong in REST API development, database performance tuning, and maintaining reliable transaction-heavy services in production environments.


EXPERIENCE
Backend Developer | PT. Zahir Internasional        Feb 2022 - Jun 2025
* Maintained dual-core backend architecture serving 4 production applications (Zahir ERP, ZahirOnline, Zahir PosX, Zahir HR) supporting 500+ clients with zero-downtime during system transition period.
* Contributed to report-generator rewrite (Node.js to Golang), translated core report logic and implemented initial Go endpoints, lowering memory footprint by 100+ MB and removing large-report out of memory failures in production.
* Resolved 25+ critical financial reporting bugs including journal inconsistencies, calculation errors, and duplicate data issues affecting profit/loss statements and balance sheets.
* Fixed 15+ transaction processing bugs addressing serial number tracking errors, inventory validation issues, and multi-currency calculation problems.
* Developed backend data-adapter endpoints to feed Jasper/HTML report templates (20+ templates) including profit/loss statements, inventory analysis, and payment tracking reports.
* Enhanced accrual handling, implemented partial allocation logic for accrued expenses/incomes and backend APIs to surface accruals in invoice flows and reports.
* Developed inventory tracking features including lot/serial number validation across multiple transaction types (transfers, adjustments, production).
* Optimized report queries and filters for financial statements including budget variance analysis, improving data accuracy and resolving calculation errors across departmental and project-level reports.


Programmer (Backend) | Universitas Islam Indonesia        May 2019 - Dec 2021
* Built microservices-based attendance system migration from legacy MS Access fingerprint system to online platform during COVID-19, serving 3000+ daily users.
* Developed database migration service to automate attendance data transfer (2000+ records daily), eliminating manual errors and ensuring data consistency.
* Built employee management system serving 3000+ daily users, standardizing workflows across multiple domains (academic, admissions, finance).
* Configured Kafka Connect connectors (registered source & sink) for cross-database synchronization, enabling real-time data propagation across microservices without manual ETL processes.
* Designed and developed REST APIs with performance optimizations including database indexing and caching strategies.
* Onboarded and mentored 8+ team members through system walkthroughs, knowledge-sharing sessions, and technical guidance.
* Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure system requirements alignment and successful project delivery.
* Maintained technical documentation in Confluence and performed comprehensive API validation testing.


Intern Web Developer | Komuri GeekGarden                                                        Nov 2017 - Dec 2017
* Contributed to production web applications using PHP (Laravel) and MySQL.
* Developed an internal project management application with task tracking functionality.
* Collaborated with senior developers on code reviews and learned software development best practices.




Web Programming Lab Assistant | Universitas Islam Indonesia        Mar 2017 - Jun 2017
* Delivered web programming lectures covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and web fundamentals.
* Mentored 10 students through course assignments and project work.
EDUCATION
Universitas Islam Indonesia | Informatika | CGPA: 3.76        Sep 2014 - Feb 2019


SKILL
* Backend Development: Golang, PHP (Laravel/Lumen), REST APIs, Microservices Architecture, Service-Oriented Architecture, Object-Oriented Programming, Software Development Life Cycle, Agile/Scrum, System Design, Legacy System Migration.
* Frontend Development: JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap.
* Databases & Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS Access, Redis (Caching), Database Optimization, Query Performance Tuning, Indexing, Data Migration, ETL Processes, Kafka Connect (Data Synchronization).
* Tools & Technologies: Docker, Git, Linux, Confluence, Postman, Jasper Reports, AWS S3.
* Performance & Quality: Performance Tuning, Memory Optimization, Debugging, Root Cause Analysis, Code Review, Pair Programming, Manual Testing, API Testing, Production Support, Incident Resolution.
* Business Domains: ERP Software (Inventory, Finance, Manufacturing), Financial Systems (Accounting, Multi-Currency, Budget Analysis), HR Information Systems, Project Management Systems, Reporting & Analytics.
* Soft Skills: Cross-functional Collaboration, Technical Mentoring & Knowledge Transfer, Technical Documentation, Problem Solving & Analytical Thinking.
